sections.Profile:
"Fighting Irish" is a single-player electro-mechanical pinball machine released by Chicago Coin Machine Manufacturing Company in November 1950. The game features two flippers, two pop bumpers, and a kick-out hole, all set against a football-themed backdrop.

- Manufacturer: Chicago Coin Machine Mfg. Co.
- Years made: 1950
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Lights
- Players: 1
- Tags: Single Player, College, Wood Rail, Sports, Football, College Football
